# KLXPU (KUNLUNXIN XPU) v1-suite deselect list.
#
# Individual tests that fail on the klxpu accelerator but live in files whose
# other tests pass; deselecting per node id keeps the rest (and new tests)
# running. Grouped by the failure actually observed (verified from a run log).
# One node id per line, relative to the repo root; blank/# lines are ignored.


# --- Triton is uninstalled on klxpu (see the workflow's "Remove Triton" step):
#     this test forces the Triton grouped-GEMM path with no availability guard,
#     so it raises instead of skipping. The other klxpu Triton failures are gone
#     because DeepSpeed's Triton ops fall back to eager when Triton is absent ---
tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_expert_activation.py::TestGroupedExpertsActivation::test_grouped_gemm_paths_match_the_for_loop[geglu_tanh-triton_grouped_mm]

tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_expert_activation.py::TestGroupedExpertsActivation::test_grouped_gemm_paths_match_the_for_loop[swiglu_clamped-triton_grouped_mm]
tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_expert_activation.py::TestGroupedExpertsActivation::test_grouped_gemm_paths_match_the_for_loop[swiglu_oai-triton_grouped_mm]

# --- bf16 elementwise accuracy: with Triton absent both sides of the comparison
#     are the eager expression, and klxpu's bf16 sigmoid/clamp/mul chain deviates
#     from the float32 reference by more than the test's one-ulp rtol=1.2e-2
#     (measured max_rel 0.069 against 0.012 allowed, 285 of 786432 elements) ---
tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_expert_activation.py::TestGroupedExpertsActivation::test_fused_kernel_matches_plain_pytorch[swiglu_oai]

# --- ZeRO-3 partial offload builds a torch device string from the private
#     accelerator name (stage3.py: subgroup_to_device[i] = get_accelerator()._name),
#     and torch rejects "klxpu"; ratio=1.0 sends every subgroup to cpu so only the
#     partial ratios reach it. Upstream bug, not klxpu-specific ---
tests/unit/v1/zero/test_zero.py::TestZero3OffloadPinnedCopyBack::test[0.5]
